e=df['eps'].values; t=df['T'].values; s=df['sigma'].values
# bin T into groups and check: for each T-bin, fit s = a + b/eps + c/eps^2 + d*eps; compare coefficients vs T
bins=np.linspace(2,6,9)
for lo,hi in zip(bins[:-1],bins[1:]):
    m=(t>=lo)&(t<hi)
    if m.sum()<8: print('few',m.sum()); continue
    A=np.column_stack([np.ones(m.sum()),1/e[m],1/e[m]**2,e[m]])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,s[m],rcond=None)[0]
    r=s[m]-A@c
